title: Harden auto-runner dry-run diagnostics
body:
Workflow tooling task limited to tools/auto-runner and docs/workflow.

## Auto-runner contract

```json
{
  "contractVersion": 1,
  "lane": "workflow-docs-tooling",
  "allowedPaths": [
    "tools/auto-runner/**",
    "docs/workflow/**"
  ],
  "validationProfile": "workflow-tooling",
  "manualMergeRequired": true,
  "autoMergeEligible": false,
  "requiredReading": [
    "PROGRAM_ARCHITECTURE.md",
    "docs/workflow/CODEX_TASK_GUIDE.md",
    "docs/workflow/AUTONOMOUS_CODEX_RUNNER.md"
  ]
}
```
